claims: Mother's Day in 2026 is celebrated on Sunday, May 10th in the United States and many other countries.
White or pink carnations are traditionally given on Mother's Day.
Mother's Day was founded by Anna Jarvis in the early 20th century to honor her mother.
Mother's Day was officially designated as a national holiday in the US in 1914 by President Woodrow Wilson.
Carnations are the traditional flower for Mother's Day.
Mother's Day in the UK is celebrated three weeks before Easter.
Mother's Day is celebrated on different dates in Mexico and South Africa.
Anna Jarvis emphasized that the purpose of Mother's Day was to focus on recognizing individual mothers within each family
